doc: v from -70 to +70 m/s in steps of 0.25 (float32, exactly representable), east ascending and north descending: every multiple of 0.25 that is odd lands on a .5 tie of 128 + v / 0.5, which np.round rounds half to EVEN (128.5 -> 128, 129.5 -> 130), and beyond +-64 m/s the clip saturates (63.75 -> 255.5 -> 256 -> 255; -64.25 -> -0.5 -> -0 -> 0). Blue is 0. Exact bytes.
